sql:
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
GROUP BY s.School, s.Phone
ORDER BY AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) DESC
LIMIT 1;
